provenance.training: Native per-joint positions/masks at four causal times; observed hip motion; horizontal mirror augmentation; strong labels plus optional latent same-ID windows after epoch10; no imputed poses or inferred ground-truth onset
provenance.selection: Prefer strictly fewer misses AND false-warning clips than prior on development, with no increase in early warnings; required named regressions; otherwise diagnostic candidate only
provenance.excluded: All cycle3/4 and EDF footage excluded from fitting and selection
